remarks: Step into this bright and inviting 3/4-bedroom apartment and feel instantly at home. This unit has been refreshed with neutral paint tones, durable vinyl flooring, and newer kitchen appliances, this light-filled unit is truly move-in ready. The open-concept living and dining areas flow seamlessly into the kitchen, offering a layout perfectly suited for today's lifestyle. Extra bedroom/office and ~1000 sq ft storage area now included! Located above a charming country convenience store in the highly sought-after Cranbury neighborhood, this rare rental includes in-unit washer and dryer and two parking spaces. Conveniently situated just minutes from major highways, grocery stores, restaurants, and all that Norwalk has to offer. Comfort, convenience, and character welcome home.
